caption: The drawing is a monochromatic, pencil illustration on off-white paper, depicting a cylindrical container that appears metallic, with a handle attached to one side near the top. The container has a slightly flared base and a domed lid that is not fully closed, as two objects protrude vertically from the lid’s opening. These protruding objects resemble paintbrushes or crude tools with tapered, textured ends. The main subject is centered within a squared border. In the lower left corner, a smaller schematic view of the same container is presented, accompanied by simple measurement lines indicating dimensions ("5" for height and "3 1/2" for width). The container and objects are rendered using closely spaced stippling and lines for shading and texture, while the border and schematic are illustrated in thin, clean lines. The overall composition is neat and balanced, with the background largely empty except for the borders. The artist's signature "A. ZHIDENBERG" appears in the lower right corner.
title: Spark Lamp
